name: SellerForge
description: Hosted read-only access to an Amazon seller's own Seller Central and Amazon Ads data: account health, FBA inventory, reimbursements, Plan of Action cases, keyword ranks, listing audits and campaigns; OAuth sign-in to a SellerForge account, 7-day trial with no card. Endpoint: `https://www.sellerforge.ai/api/mcp` · Registry: `ai.sellerforge/sellerforge`
